edges.reason: constructor sets _rOwned[_msgSender()] = _rTotal, making the deployer the sole initial holder.
Ownable constructor stores _msgSender() as _owner, defining privileged control.
approve passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transfer sends from _msgSender().
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for allowance reduction.
balanceOf can be queried with any caller-supplied account.
manualswap authorizes via require(_msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1).
manualsend authorizes via require(_msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1).
_msgSender returns msg.sender.
cooldown[to] is compared to and assigned from block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom reduces allowance through _approve.
approve writes allowances through _approve.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender].
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth (external router call) before token balances are updated in _tokenTransfer.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee which pushes ETH externally during the transfer flow.
_transfer finalizes accounting via _tokenTransfer.
_transfer enforces require(amount <= _maxTxAmount) for pair buys.
_transfer enforces require(!bots[from] && !bots[to]) blacklist check.
_transfer reads the inSwap guard before swapping.
_transfer reads swapEnabled before performing the auto swap.
_transfer writes cooldown[to] after the timestamp check.
onlyOwner setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router (WETH and swap target).
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
swapTokensForEth calls _approve to grant router allowance.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet1.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet2.
sendETHToFee reads _feeAddrWallet1 as recipient.
sendETHToFee reads _feeAddrWallet2 as recipient.
openTrading assigns the hardcoded router to uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair in uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading calls router.addLiquidityETH with the whole contract balance.
openTrading calls factory.createPair externally.
openTrading calls _approve for the router and the pair.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled.
openTrading sets the tradingOpen guard flag.
openTrading overwrites _maxTxAmount with a 5e21 limit.
onlyOwner setBots writes bots[] entries, controlling who can trade.
setBots iterates with the loop index i.
onlyOwner removeStrictTxLimit sets _maxTxAmount back to full supply.
onlyOwner delBot clears the bots blacklist entry.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard updates _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team share.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the fee share.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_takeTeam calls _getRate to convert token to reflection amount.
_takeTeam credits _rOwned[address(this)].
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by rFee.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by tFee.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues.
_getValues calls _getRate.
_getTValues reads the _feeAddr1 tax percentage.
_getTValues reads the _feeAddr2 team percentage.
_getRValues uses the currentRate local value.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal and _tTotal for the supply check.
tokenFromReflection calls _getRate.
tokenFromReflection requires rAmount <= _rTotal.
balanceOf converts via tokenFromReflection.
balanceOf reads _rOwned[account].
renounceOwnership sets _owner = address(0), irreversibly removing owner controls.
owner() returns the stored _owner.
_transfer computes contractTokenBalance from balanceOf(address(this)).
_transfer reads address(this).balance into contractETHBalance before sending.
setBots iterates over the caller-supplied bots_ array.
delBot writes bots[notbot] = false using the supplied address.
setCooldownEnabled assigns the onoff parameter to cooldownEnabled.
sendETHToFee splits the amount parameter between the two fee wallets.
swapTokensForEth forwards tokenAmount to the router swap.
_transferStandard passes tAmount into _getValues.
transfer forwards the amount parameter into _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to carry caller input into the transfer flow, so it is normalized into the transfer function node.
tAmount is the private accounting amount of _transferStandard and has no meaning outside that function.
tokenAmount is the internal swap size argument of swapTokensForEth and should collapse into it.
amount is the ETH amount distributed by sendETHToFee and merges into that function.
onoff is the only input of setCooldownEnabled and is absorbed by the setter.
bots_ is the caller-supplied blacklist array consumed entirely inside setBots.
notbot is the single address argument of delBot and is absorbed by it.
contractTokenBalance is a transient snapshot local to _transfer's auto-swap branch.
contractETHBalance is a transient snapshot local to _transfer's fee distribution branch.
currentRate is derived from _getRate() and used only for the reflection conversion in tokenFromReflection.
i is a loop index confined to setBots and adds no semantic value.
